function Get-Category {
    param([int]$Number)

    if ($Number -lt 0) { return Get-NegativeCategory -Number $Number }
    if ($Number -eq 0) { return 'zero' }
    if ($Number -ge 100) { return 'large' }
    return 'positive'
}

function Get-NegativeCategory {
    param([int]$Number)

    if ($Number -le -100) { return 'very-negative' }
    return 'negative'
}
